titleEn: The Glory of Kings — Solomon's Answer and the Pharaoh's Daughter (ch. 62–63)
part: ch. 62–63 — Solomon's Answer and the Pharaoh's Daughter
about: After the Ark is taken, Solomon tells the leaders of Israel that nothing is impossible for God, prays with them in the sanctuary, and proposes a replica of Zion; the elders pledge to keep the matter from the nations. Eleven years later Solomon's love of women, above all of Pharaoh's daughter and her idols, turns his heart from God.

sentences.t: ፷፪ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘአውሥኦሙ ፡ ሰሎሞን ።
sentences.l: 62. Concerning that-which-answered-them Solomon
sentences.i: Chapter 62: Concerning what Solomon answered them
sentences.n: Chapter heading; Ethiopic numeral ፷፪ = 62 (፷ 60 + ፪ 2). በእንተ 'concerning' takes what follows as a clause. ዘአውሥኦሙ: ዘ- 'that which' + አውሥአ 'answered' (causative of ወሥአ) + -ሙ 'them'; the subject ሰሎሞን follows the verb, as usual in Geʿez.

sentences.t: ወአውሥኦሙ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ስምዑኒ ፡ ዘእነግረክሙ ፡ ኪያየ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ወሰደኒ ፡ እንዘ ፡ እጸውር ፡ ኪያሃ ፡ ምንት ፡ እምተስእኖ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወኪያክሙኒ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ይወስደክሙ ፡ ጸዊረክ ፡ ሙ ፡ ኪያሃ ፡ ምንት ፡ እምተስእኖ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወሶበሂ ፡ ያወርሶሙ ፡ ሀገርነ ፡ ወይሤርወነ ፡ ኪያነ ፡ ምንት ፡ እምተስእኖ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: And-answered-them Solomon king, and-said-to-them: Hear-me what-I-tell-you: me, when he-took-me while I-bear her, what (is) from-impossibility(?) to-God? And-you-too, when he-takes-you, your-bearing her, what (is) from-impossibility(?) to-God? And-when-also he-gives-them-to-inherit our-country and-uproots(?)-us, us, what (is) from-impossibility(?) to-God;
sentences.i: King Solomon answered them and said to them: Hear what I have to tell you. If he took me away while I was bearing her, what is impossible for God? And if he takes you away, with you bearing her, what is impossible for God? And if he gives them our country to inherit and uproots us, what is impossible for God?
sentences.n: A speech in three parallel 'if' clauses, each closed by the same question: ምንት እምተስእኖ ለእግዚኣብሔር. Read ኪያየ, ኪያሃ, ኪያነ as accusative pronouns put first for emphasis ('me', 'her', 'us'); ኪያሃ 'her' is the Ark Zion (feminine), the object of እጸውር 'I carry' (ጸወረ). ወሰደኒ: ወሰደ 'took, led away' + -ኒ 'me'; ይወስደክሙ: the same verb, 3ms imperfect + -ክሙ 'you (pl.)'. ጸዊረክሙ: infinitive + -ክሙ 'your bearing' (written ጸዊረክ ፡ ሙ with a stray word-space; read as one word). The subject of 'took' is God, the speaker's point being that the Ark's removal is within God's power. ተስእኖ 'impossibility, hardship' (?) with እም- 'from/of': 'what is there of impossibility for God'; I read the idiom as 'what is impossible for God', close in force to Genesis 18:14 / Jeremiah 32:17 (?). ያወርሶሙ: አወረሰ 'cause to inherit' (causative of ወረሰ), double object 'them (-ሙ)' and 'our country'; who 'they' are is not stated, presumably the foreign peoples (?). ይሤርወነ: ሠረወ, from ሥርው 'root', 'uproot, tear out' (?). Proclitics: ወ- 'and', ለ- marking God as indirect object, -ሂ and -ኒ 'also' attached to ወሶበሂ and ወኪያክሙኒ; እንዘ 'while' + imperfect.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘየአብያ ፡ ለፈቃዱ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘይትዐደው ፡ እምትእዛዙ ፡ በሰማይ ፡ በላዕሉ ፡ ወበምድር ፡ በታሕቱ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ዘኢይሰዐር ፡ መንግሥቱ ፡ ለዓለመ ፡ ዓለም ፡ አሜን ።
sentences.l: For all to-him; and-there-is-not he-who-refuses(?) to-his-will, and-there-is-not he-who-transgresses from-his-command; in-heaven in-above-it and-on-earth in-beneath-it king he-is, he-who not is-abolished his-kingdom for-age-of age. Amen.
sentences.i: For all things are his, and there is no one who refuses his will and no one who transgresses his command. In heaven above and on earth below, he is king, he whose kingdom will not be abolished for ever and ever. Amen.
sentences.n: እስመ 'for' gives the ground of the argument. ሎቱ is ለ- 'to' + -ቱ 'him': 'all is his'. ወአልቦ ዘ- 'and there is none who...' (አልቦ + ዘ- relative). ዘየአብያ: a form of አበየ 'refuse, be unwilling' (?); the ending -ያ is unexpected and the exact parse is uncertain, but the sense (none resists his will) is clear. ዘይትዐደው: tä-stem of ዐደወ 'transgress, cross over', with እም- 'from' the command. በላዕሉ ... በታሕቱ 'above ... below', adverbs with በ-. ዘኢይሰዐር መንግሥቱ: ዘ- 'whose/who' with ሰዐረ 'abolish, undo'; the verb is 3ms imperfect with መንግሥቱ 'his kingdom' as its subject, taken as 'whose kingdom is not abolished' (?). ለዓለመ ዓለም 'for the age of ages', the construct state, = 'for ever'. The ዓለም ... አሜን ending is a doxology.

sentences.t: ወባሕቱ ፡ ንሖር ፡ ንትጋነይ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፨
sentences.l: And-but let-us-go let-us-bow(?) in-within house-of God;
sentences.i: But let us go and bow in worship in the house of God.
sentences.n: ወባሕቱ 'and but'. ንሖር is 1cp jussive of ሖረ 'go' and ንትጋነይ 1cp jussive of ተጋነየ (tä-stem of ገነየ 'serve, bow oneself, do homage'), so 'let us go, let us worship'; Geʿez often strings two jussives together without 'and'. በውስተ ቤተ እግዚኣብሔር: ቤተ is construct, 'house-of God'. The unit closes at ፨, the section mark.

sentences.t: ወሖሩ ፡ ሊቃውንተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ምስለ ፡ ንጉሦሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወቦኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቅድስተ ፡ ቅዱሳን ፡ ወሰአሉ ፡ ወተጋነዩ ፡ ወበፅዑ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: And-went leaders-of Israel with their-king into house-of God, and-entered into holy-of holies, and-asked and-bowed and-implored(?) to-God;
sentences.i: The leaders of Israel went with their king into the house of God, and they entered the Holy of Holies, and they prayed, and bowed down, and made their entreaty (?) to God.
sentences.n: Five perfect verbs in a row, all with 'they' as subject: ወሖሩ (ሖረ 'went'), ወቦኡ (ቦአ 'entered'), ወሰአሉ (ሰአለ 'asked, prayed'), ወተጋነዩ (ተጋነየ 'bowed in worship', as in the last unit), ወበፅዑ (በፅዐ, here 'entreated, besought' (?); related to ብፅዓት 'vow, petition'). ሊቃውንተ is the construct form (subject here) of ሊቃውንት, plural of ሊቅ 'chief, elder, master': 'chiefs of Israel'. ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን 'holy-of holies', a construct chain; the Holy of Holies, where the Ark would have stood. ለእግዚኣብሔር marks God as the one entreated.

sentences.t: ወሰሎሞንሂ ፡ በከየ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ምንባሪሃ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ሰማያዊት ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወበከዩ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ ወእምድኅረ ፡ ሕቅ ፡ አርመሙ ፨
sentences.l: And-Solomon-too wept in-within her-seat of-Zion heavenly, ark-of his-law of-God; and-wept all-of-them with-him; and-after a-little they-fell-silent.
sentences.i: Solomon too wept, in the seat of heavenly Zion, the ark of God's law, and all of them wept with him; and after a little while they fell silent.
sentences.n: ወሰሎሞንሂ: ወ- 'and' + the name + enclitic -ሂ 'also'. ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'her seat, belonging to Zion' (anticipatory suffix -ሃ, then the owner with ለ-), a spelling of መንበር 'seat, throne'; here the empty place in the sanctuary where Zion stood. ሰማያዊት is the feminine of ሰማያዊ 'heavenly' agreeing with ጽዮን; ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'ark of his law, God's' is in apposition (construct plus anticipating suffix). Zion is the ታቦት, the Ark, which is the book's central theology. ወበከዩ: በከየ 'wept', 3mp perfect. ሕቅ 'a little'. አርመሙ: አርመመ 'fell silent' (?), 3mp perfect.

sentences.t: አውሥአ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ኅድጉኬ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢይትመክሑ ፡ ቈላፋን ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ላዕሌነ ፡ ወኢይበሉነ ፡ ተነሥተ ፡ ክብሮሙ ፡ ወኀደጎሙ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: Answered Solomon and-said-to-them: Leave-it-then, that-not they-boast uncircumcised people over-us, and-not they-say-to-us: Taken-away (was) their-glory and-forsook-them God;
sentences.i: Solomon answered and said to them: Let it be, then, so that the uncircumcised people may not boast over us, saying to us, 'Their glory was taken away, and God abandoned them.'
sentences.n: ኅድጉኬ: ኀደገ 'leave, let go' in the 2mp imperative + -ኬ 'then, now'; here 'let it rest', i.e. stop the weeping. ከመ ኢ- + jussive ('that not'): ይትመክሑ (ተመክሐ 'boast, glory in') and ይበሉነ (ብህለ 'say' + -ነ 'to us'). ቈላፋን, plural of ቈላፍ 'uncircumcised', is the usual word for gentiles; Solomon fears their mockery. The quoted words: ተነሥተ (3ms perfect, tä-stem, passive of ነሠተ 'take away'; it may rather be a short spelling of ተነሥአ 'rose up, departed', the verb used of Zion in ch. 63, so the sense is uncertain (?)) ክብሮሙ 'their glory'; ወኀደጎሙ 'and forsook them'. ሕዝብ is the singular collective 'people'; ላዕሌነ 'over/against us'.

sentences.t: ኢትክሥቱ ፡ እምዝ ፡ ዳግመ ፡ ለባዕዳን ፡ ሕዝብ ፤
sentences.l: Do-not-reveal from-this again to-foreigners people;
sentences.i: Do not, from now on, reveal it again to the foreign peoples.
sentences.n: ኢትክሥቱ: ከሠተ 'uncover, reveal', 2mp jussive with ኢ- as a prohibition (ኢ + jussive = 'do not'); no object is spoken, 'it' (the Ark's departure) is understood. እምዝ ዳግመ 'from this (time), again' (እም- + ዝ + the adverb ዳግመ). ለባዕዳን ሕዝብ 'to foreign people': the plural ባዕዳን of ባዕድ 'other, strange', ለ- marking the person told.

sentences.t: ወእሉሂ ፡ አልዋሕ ፡ እለ ፡ ስሙካን ፡ ወልጹቃን ፡ ዝየ ፡ ንሢሞን ፡ ወንልብጦን ፡ በወርቅ ፡ ወናሰርግዎን ፡ በአምሳለ ፡ እግዝእትነ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ወመጽሐፈ ፡ ሕግሂ ፡ ናንብር ፡ ውስቴታ ፤
sentences.l: And-these-too boards(?) which (are) set-close(?) and-joined(?) here: let-us-set-them and-let-us-overlay-them with-gold and-let-us-adorn-them in-likeness-of our-lady Zion, and-book-of law-too let-us-place within-her;
sentences.i: And these boards (?) here, which are fixed (?) and joined together (?), let us set them in place, overlay them with gold and adorn them in the likeness of our lady Zion; and let us also place the book of the law within it.
sentences.n: Solomon proposes a replica of the Ark. አልዋሕ is the broken plural of ሉሕ 'board, tablet' (the lemma is ሉሕ, not ሊሕ); 'boards' is the safer sense here, since a replica is being made and the book of the law is to be laid inside it, though 'tablets' is possible (?); it takes feminine plural agreement (the -ን 'them' on the verbs; ስሙካን, ልጹቃን as feminine plurals). The two adjectives are uncertain: ስሙካን (?) perhaps 'propped, set fast', ልጹቃን 'joined, clinging' (from ለጸቀ 'cling'). Four 1cp jussives: ንሢሞን (ሠይመ 'set, appoint' + -ን 'them'), ንልብጦን (ልብጠ 'wrap, overlay' (?)), ናሰርግዎን (አሰርገወ 'adorn'), ናንብር (አንበረ 'place, set down'); በወርቅ 'with gold' and በአምሳለ 'in the likeness of' (construct). እግዝእትነ ጽዮን 'our lady Zion' (feminine, as everywhere). መጽሐፈ ሕግሂ: 'book-of law' (construct) + -ሂ 'also'. ውስቴታ 'within her/it' (the replica).

sentences.t: ወሀለወት ፡ ኀቤነ ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ፡ አግ ፡ ዓዚት ፡ እንተ ፡ በሰማያት ፡ መልዕልቴነ ፡ ዘርእየ ፡ ያዕቆብ ፡ አቡነ ፡ ወእምታሕቴሃ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ አንቀጸ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ እንተ ፡ በምድር ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ።
sentences.l: And-is with-us Jerusalem the-free-one, which in-the-heavens above-us, that-which-saw Jacob our-father, and-from-beneath-her this-one is-she, gate-of heaven which on-earth (is) Jerusalem.
sentences.i: And with us there is the heavenly Jerusalem, the free one, which is in the heavens above us, the one that our father Jacob saw; and beneath it is this one, the gate of heaven which is on earth, Jerusalem.
sentences.n: Two scriptural allusions. 'Jerusalem the free one above' is Galatians 4:26 ('the Jerusalem above is free'); 'gate of heaven' and 'what Jacob saw' is Genesis 28:12–17 (the ladder, 'this is the gate of heaven'). The printed text splits አግዓዚት (አግዓዚ 'free', feminine -ት) as አግ ፡ ዓዚት, a word-space slip; read as one word. ወሀለወት ኀቤነ 'and there is, with us' (ሀሎ 'be present', 3fs perfect). መልዕልቴነ 'above us' (መልዕልት 'upper part' + -ነ). ዘርእየ ያዕቆብ: ዘ- 'that which' + 3ms perfect, subject after the verb. ወእምታሕቴሃ 'and from beneath her', then ዛቲ ይእቲ 'this is she', the demonstrative with the copula-pronoun. The earthly city is the 'gate' to the heavenly one.

sentences.t: ለእመ ፡ ገበርነ ፡ ፈቃዶ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወሥምረቶ ፡ ይሄሉ ፡ እግዚኣብሔርኒ ፡ ምስሌነ ፡ ወያነግፈነ ፡ እምእደ ፡ ፀርነ ፡ ወእምእደ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይጸልኡነ ፤
sentences.l: If we-do his-will, God's, and-his-pleasure, will-be God-also with-us, and-he-will-snatch-us(?) from-hand-of our-enemy and-from-hand-of all-of-them who they-hate-us;
sentences.i: If we do God's will and what pleases him, then God too will be with us, and he will rescue us from the hand of our enemy and from the hand of all who hate us.
sentences.n: ለእመ + perfect ገበርነ 'if we do' (ገብረ 'do, make'). ፈቃዶ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'his will, God's' (suffix, then the owner with ለ-). ወሥምረቶ 'and his pleasure' (ሥምረት + the accusative -ኦ 'his', written ሥምረቶ). እግዚኣብሔርኒ 'God also' (-ኒ), ይሄሉ 3ms (ሀሎ). ያነግፈነ: አንገፈ 'snatch away, rescue' (?), ʾa-stem imperfect + -ነ 'us'; the exact stem is uncertain, the sense 'deliver' is clear from the context. እምእደ 'from the hand of' (እድ, construct). እለ ይጸልኡነ 'who hate us' (ጸልአ 'hate' + -ነ).

sentences.t: ወይኩን ፡ ፈቃዶ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአኮ ፡ ፈቃደ ፡ ዚአነ ፡ ወይኩን ፡ ሥምረተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአኮ ፡ ሥምረተ ፡ ዚአነ ፤
sentences.l: And-let-be his-will of-God and-not will-of ours, and-let-be pleasure-of God and-not pleasure-of ours;
sentences.i: Let it be God's will and not ours, and let it be God's pleasure and not ours.
sentences.n: ወይኩን ... ወአኮ 'let it be ... and not': ይኩን is the 3ms jussive of ኮነ 'be'; አኮ is the negative of the copula, used for a noun-predicate. ፈቃዶ ለእግዚኣብሔር and ፈቃደ ዚአነ: the first has an anticipating suffix (ፈቃድ + -ኦ 'his', written ፈቃዶ), the second the construct (ፈቃደ 'will-of') before the independent possessive ዚአነ 'ours'. The sentiment is that of Luke 22:42 / Matthew 26:39 ('not my will but yours').

sentences.t: ወበይእቲሰ ፡ አሕዘነነ ፡ ወባሕቱ ፡ እምይእዜሰ ፡ ያቈርር ፡ መዐቶ ፡ እምኔነ ፡ ወኢየኀድገነ ፡ ለጸላእትነ ፡ ወኢያርሕቅ ፡ ሣህሎ ፡ እምኔነ ፤
sentences.l: And-in-that-one-indeed he-grieved-us, and-but from-now-indeed he-will-cool his-wrath from-us, and-not he-will-leave-us to-our-enemies, and-not he-will-put-far his-mercy from-us;
sentences.i: He has indeed grieved us over that matter, but from now on he will cool his anger toward us, and he will not leave us to our enemies, nor take his mercy far from us.
sentences.n: ወበይእቲሰ: በ- 'in' + the feminine pronoun ይእቲ 'that (one)' + the contrastive -ሰ; the antecedent is not stated, presumably Zion's departure or the sin behind it (?). አሕዘነነ: አሕዘነ 'grieve', causative of ሐዘነ, 3ms perfect + -ነ. ያቈርር: አቈረረ 'make cold, cool', from ቈረረ 'be cold'; the 'cooling' of wrath is an image of anger abating. ኢየኀድገነ and ኢያርሕቅ: the negated imperfects of ኀደገ 'leave' and አርሐቀ 'put far' (causative of ርሕቀ). ለጸላእትነ 'to our enemies' (ጸላእት, plural of ጸላኢ). ሣህሎ 'his mercy'. The three 'he will' verbs promise reversal.

sentences.t: ተዘኪሮ ፡ ኪዳነ ፡ ዘምስለ ፡ አበዊነ ፡ አብርሃም ፡ ወይስሐቅ ፡ ወያዕቆብ ፡ ኢይሔሱ ፡ ቃሎ ፡ ወኢይዔምፅ ፡ ኪዳኖ ፡ ከመ ፡ ኢያማስን ፡ ዘርኦሙ ፡ ለአበዊነ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: Remembering covenant that-with our-fathers Abraham and-Isaac and-Jacob, not he-will-falsify(?) his-word and-not he-will-break(?) his-covenant, that-not he-destroy seed-of-them of-our-fathers.
sentences.i: Remembering the covenant with our fathers Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, he will not falsify his word or break his covenant, so as not to destroy the offspring of our fathers.
sentences.n: ተዘኪሮ: ተዘከረ 'remember' (Gt), here an infinitive/gerund with the subject God from the previous unit: 'remembering the covenant'. ኪዳነ is the accusative of ኪዳን 'covenant'; ዘምስለ 'which (is) with'. The patriarchs recall God's covenant in Genesis 15 and 17 (Exodus 2:24). ኢይሔሱ: probably ሐሰወ 'lie, falsify' (?), 3ms jussive; ኢይዔምፅ: ዐመጸ 'act unjustly, break' (?) with ኢ-. ከመ ኢያማስን 'that he not destroy' (አማሰነ 'destroy'). ዘርኦሙ ለአበዊነ 'the seed of them, of our fathers' (anticipatory suffix). The ፨ ፨ ፨ closes chapter 62.

sentences.t: ፷፫ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኀበሩ ፡ ዐበይተ ፡ እስራኤል ።
sentences.l: 63. Where united great-ones-of Israel.
sentences.i: Chapter 63: Where the great men of Israel united (?)
sentences.n: Chapter heading; ፷፫ = 63. ኀበ 'where' (conjunction) opens a clause, 'where the great ones of Israel united'; since the chapter tells of their agreement with Solomon, a sense 'in the matter in which they agreed' is possible (?). ኀበሩ: 3mp perfect of ኀብረ 'unite, agree'. ዐበይተ is the construct plural (subject here) of ዐቢይ 'great', 'great ones, nobles'.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ አውሥእዎ ፡ መላህቅተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወይቤልዎ ፡ ትኩን ፡ ሥምረትከ ፡ ወሥምረተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ አምላክከ ፡ ወንሕነሰ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ዘንትዐደው ፡ እምቃልከ ፡ ወኢናየድዖሙ ፡ ለባዕድ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ከመ ፡ ተነሥአት ፡ ጽዮን ፡ እምኔነ ።
sentences.l: And-then answered-him elders(?)-of Israel and-said-to-him: May-be your-pleasure and-pleasure-of God your-God; and-as-for-us, there-is-not that-we-transgress from-your-word, and-not we-will-make-known(?)-them to-foreign nations that rose Zion from-us.
sentences.i: Then the elders of Israel answered him and said to him: Let your pleasure be, and the pleasure of God, your God. As for us, we will not transgress your word, and we will not tell the foreign nations that Zion has risen up from among us.
sentences.n: መላህቅተ 'elders', the construct plural of መልህቅ, which properly means 'anchor'; the sense 'stays of the people, elders' is taken from context and from the same word's use elsewhere in this work (?). አውሥእዎ 'they answered him' and ወይቤልዎ 'and they said to him' (ብህለ 'say'; -ልዎ 'to him'); ትኩን 3fs jussive of ኮነ, matching ሥምረትከ 'your pleasure'. ወንሕነሰ: 'and we' with the contrastive -ሰ. አልቦ ዘንትዐደው 'there is nothing that we transgress', with ዘ- + 1cp imperfect of ተዐደወ. ኢናየድዖሙ: አየድዐ 'make known, inform' (?), a rare verb, 1cp imperfect + -ሙ 'them', anticipating ለባዕድ አሕዛብ (?); the thing told is 'that Zion has gone', in the ከመ clause. ተነሥአት ጽዮን: ተንሥአ 'rise, depart', 3fs perfect; 'Zion has risen from us' is this work's phrase for the Ark's departure.

sentences.t: ወአቀሙ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ኪዳነ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ መላህቅተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ምስለ ፡ ንጉሦሙ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ እስከ ፡ ይእዜ ፨
sentences.l: And-established this covenant within house-of God elders(?)-of Israel with their-king Solomon until now;
sentences.i: And the elders of Israel, with their king Solomon, established this covenant in the house of God, and so it has stood until now.
sentences.n: አቀሙ: አቀመ 'set up, establish', 3mp perfect (the verb with ኪዳን 'covenant' means 'make a covenant'), with ዘንተ ኪዳነ the accusative of the demonstrative and noun. Subject follows: መላህቅተ እስራኤል ምስለ ንጉሦሙ. እስከ ይእዜ 'until now' is the narrator's present: the covenant is said to be still in force at the time of writing. The unit closes at ፨.

sentences.t: ወሰሎሞንሰ ፡ ነበረ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ተነሥአት ፡ ጽዮን ፡ እምኔሁ ፡ ዐሠርቱ ፡ ወአሐዱ ፡ ዓመተወእምዝ ፡ አእተተ ፡ ልቦ ፡ እምፍቅረ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወረስዐ ፡ ጥበቦ ፡ እምብዝኀ ፡ ፍቅረ ፡ አንስት ፤
sentences.l: And-Solomon-indeed lived after rose Zion from-him ten and-one year, and-then he-withdrew his-heart from-love-of God, and-forgot his-wisdom from-abundance-of love-of women;
sentences.i: As for Solomon, he lived on for eleven years after Zion rose up from him, and then he withdrew his heart from the love of God and forgot his wisdom through his great love of women.
sentences.n: ወሰሎሞንሰ: 'and as for Solomon' (-ሰ contrastive). The numeral ዐሠርቱ ወአሐዱ 'ten and one' (eleven) stands before the singular ዓመተ 'years'. The text writes ዓመተወእምዝ with no word-space, for ዓመተ ፡ ወእምዝ 'years, and then'. እምድኅረ ተነሥአት ጽዮን እምኔሁ: 'after rose Zion from him' (clause after a preposition). አእተተ ልቦ: አእተተ 'withdraw, take away' (?) with ልቦ 'his heart' as object, and እም- 'from'. ወረስዐ ጥበቦ: ረስዐ 'forget', with እም- giving the cause, 'from (because of) the abundance of love of women'; ብዝኀ ፍቅረ 'abundance-of love-of', a double construct. This follows 1 Kings 11:1–4, where Solomon's foreign wives turn his heart from God.

sentences.t: ወአፍቀራ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ለወለተ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ግብጽ ፡ እንተ ፡ ስማ ፡ ማቅሣራ ፡ ወአእተዋ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤቱ ፡ ዘገብረ ፡ አምሳለ ፡ ፀሐይ ፡ ወወርኅ ፡ ወከዋክብት ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጠፈራ ፡ ዘያበርህ ፡ ሌሊተ ፡ ከመ ፡ መዐልት ፤
sentences.l: And-he-loved-her exceedingly, the-daughter-of Pharaoh king-of Egypt, whose her-name (was) Maqsara; and-he-brought-her into his-house which he-made likeness-of sun and-moon and-stars in her-vault which gives-light night like day;
sentences.i: He loved the daughter of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, exceedingly; her name was Maqsara. And he brought her into his house, in the vault of which he had made likenesses of the sun, the moon and the stars, so that it gave light by night as by day.
sentences.n: ወአፍቀራ: አፍቀረ 'love', 3ms perfect + -ኣ 'her', with the object doubled by ለወለተ ፈርዖን (ለ- marks the object); ወለተ ፈርዖን 'daughter-of Pharaoh' and ንጉሠ ግብጽ 'king-of Egypt' are construct chains. እንተ ስማ 'whose name' (lit. 'which her name'); the name ማቅሣራ varies with መቅሣራ below, a spelling variant, and is not a name found in the Bible. ወአእተዋ: አእተወ 'bring in', + -ኣ 'her'. ዘገብረ 'which he made', a relative clause on 'his house', with the object አምሳለ 'likeness-of' (construct) of sun, moon and stars. ጠፈራ: ጠፈር 'firmament, vault' + -ኣ 'its/her'. ዘያበርህ: አበርሀ 'give light', causative of በርሀ, 'which lights', with ሌሊተ 'by night' (accusative of time) and ከመ መዐልት 'like day'. Whether ዘያበርህ goes with the vault or the likenesses is not fixed (?).

sentences.t: ወሥረዊሁ ፡ ብርት ፡ ወተድባቡ ፡ ብሩር ፡ ወደፍዳፉ ፡ ዐረር ፡ ወመንድቀ ፡ እብኑ ፡ አፍራጽ ፡ በአስዋድ ፡ አሕማር ፡ በአብያድ ፡ አክደር ፡ ወጸፍጸፉኒ ፡ አብላቀ ፡ ሶፎር ፡ ወእብነ ፡ ሰርዴዮን ፤
sentences.l: And-its-beams(?) iron(?) and-its-dome silver and-its-thresholds(?) bronze and-wall-of its-stone pieces(?) in-black red, in-white green, and-its-pavement-also ingots(?)-of Ophir and-stone-of sardius;
sentences.i: Its beams were of iron (?), its dome of silver, its thresholds (?) of bronze; its stone wall was of slabs (?), in black and red, in white and green; and its pavement too was of ingots (?) of Ophir and stones of sardius.
sentences.n: A list of building materials, mostly nominal sentences (no verb): ወሥረዊሁ ብርት 'and its beams (?) iron (?)', noun with suffix, then the material. Words to read with caution: ሥረዊ 'beam, support' (?); ብርት (?) perhaps 'iron' (cf. Amharic ብረት); ተድባብ 'dome, canopy'; ደፍዳፍ (?) 'thresholds, doorsteps' (a reduplicated form of ደፍ); ዐረር 'bronze' (?); መንድቅ 'wall' (construct መንድቀ) before እብኑ 'its stone' (እብን + -ሁ); አፍራጽ (?) 'pieces, slabs'. በአስዋድ አሕማር በአብያድ አክደር: four colour words, borrowed Arabic masculine singular colour adjectives of the afʿal pattern (compare Arabic aswad 'black', aḥmar 'red', abyaḍ 'white', akhḍar 'green'), not plurals; read as pairs, 'in black and red, in white and green' (?). ጸፍጸፍ 'pavement, floor' + -ሁ + -ኒ 'also'. አብላቅ (?) 'ingots' (?), and ሶፎር is Ophir (the Greek Sophir, in the Septuagint for Ophir); ሰርዴዮን is the Greek sardion, 'sardius, carnelian' (cf. Exodus 28:17). The unit ends at ፤.

sentences.t: ወየሐውር ፡ ወይነብር ፡ ህየ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ፍቅረ ፡ ቤቱ ፡ ወብእሲቱ ፡ መቅሣራ ፡ ወለተ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ግብጽ ።
sentences.l: And-he-goes and-dwells there because-of love-of his-house and-his-wife Maqsara daughter-of Pharaoh king-of Egypt.
sentences.i: He would go and live there, for love of his house and of his wife Maqsara, the daughter of Pharaoh, king of Egypt.
sentences.n: ወየሐውር ወይነብር: two 3ms imperfects (ሖረ 'go', ነበረ 'sit, dwell'), here with the sense of habit, 'he used to go and stay'. ህየ 'there', the house just described. በእንተ ፍቅረ ቤቱ ወብእሲቱ 'because of love-of his house and his wife': ፍቅረ is construct, and both ቤቱ and ብእሲቱ depend on it. ወለተ ፈርዖን ንጉሠ ግብጽ is accusative apposition to መቅሣራ (spelled ማቅሣራ above).

sentences.t: ወይእቲሰ ፡ ባቲ ፡ ጣዖታተ ፡ ዘወሀባ ፡ አቡሃ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትስግድ ፡ ሎሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-she-indeed, in-her (were) idols which gave-her her-father, that she-might-bow to-them;
sentences.i: And she had idols which her father had given her, that she might bow down to them.
sentences.n: ወይእቲሰ 'and as for her' (the feminine pronoun with -ሰ). ባቲ: በ + -ቲ 'in/with her', the Geʿez way of saying 'she has' (a possessive use of በ). ዘወሀባ: ዘ- 'which' + ወሀበ 'gave', 3ms perfect + -ኣ 'her'; the subject አቡሃ 'her father' follows. ከመ ትስግድ 'that she might bow': ከመ + 3fs jussive of ሰገደ 'bow down, worship', with ሎሙ 'to them' (ለ- + -ሙ). ጣዖታተ is the accusative plural of ጣዖት 'idol', a Greek loan.

sentences.t: ወበእንተዝ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይሬእያ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ትሠውዕ ፡ ወትሰግድ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ኢገሠጻ ፡ ወኢኀደጋ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ወበእንተዝ ፡ ተምዕዖ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአርስዖ ፡ ጥበቢሁ ።
sentences.l: And-because-of-this, while he-saw-her while she-sacrifices and-bows to-them, not he-rebuked-her and-not he-left-her, Solomon; and-because-of-this was-angry-with-him God and-made-him-forget his-wisdom.
sentences.i: And so, though he saw her sacrificing and bowing down to them, Solomon neither rebuked her nor sent her away; and for this reason God was angry with him and made him forget his wisdom.
sentences.n: በእንተዝ 'on account of this' (በእንተ + ዝ), twice, joining Solomon's neglect with God's anger. እንዘ ይሬእያ እንዘ ትሠውዕ: 'while he saw her, while she sacrificed': ይሬእያ is ርእየ 3ms imperfect + -ኣ 'her', and ትሠውዕ is the 3fs imperfect of ሠውዐ 'sacrifice' (the form is the same as the 2ms; here the subject is she, so 3fs). ኢገሠጻ ... ወኢኀደጋ: negated perfects of ገሠጸ 'rebuke' and ኀደገ 'leave, send away' + -ኣ 'her'. ተምዕዖ 'was angry with him' (ተምዕዐ + -ሁ). ወአርስዖ: አርሰዐ 'cause to forget', causative of ረስዐ, + -ሁ 'him'; ጥበቢሁ 'his wisdom', the object that comes after the suffixed verb. Compare 1 Kings 11:9–11.

sentences.t: ወይእቲሰ ፡ አፈድፈደት ፡ ሠዊዐ ፡ ወሰጊደ ፡ ወተውኔተ ፡ በከመ ፡ እበዶሙ ፡ ለግብጻዊያን ፡ ወይሰግዱ ፡ ለጣዖት ፡ ወተምህሩ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ቤታ ፡ ተውኔተ ፡ ጣዖታት ፡ ወበአስተኣድሞ ፡ ሐውዘ ፡ ተውኔቶሙ ፡ ይሰግዱ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ለወለተ ፡ ፈርዖን ፡ ወኀብሩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወአንስት ፡ ወአእማቲሃ ፡ ኀብሩ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ በሰጊድ ፡ ወበተዋንዮ ፡ ለጣዖታ ፤
sentences.l: And-she-indeed increased sacrificing and-bowing and-revelry according-to their-folly of-the-Egyptians, and-they-bow to-idol; and-were-taught all men-of her-house revelry-of idols; and-in-delight(?) ሐውዘ(?)-of their-revelry they-bow with-her, to-daughter-of Pharaoh, and-united sons-of Israel with-her, and-women and-her-maidservants united with-her in-bowing and-in-reveling for-her-idol;
sentences.i: And she did more and more sacrificing and bowing down and reveling, after the folly of the Egyptians; and they bow down to the idol; and all the men of her household learned the revels of the idols; and, delighting (?) in ሐውዘ (?) their revelry, they bowed down with her, the daughter of Pharaoh; and the sons of Israel joined with her, and the women and her maidservants joined with her in bowing down and in reveling for her idol;
sentences.n: አፈድፈደት: አፈድፈደ 'do exceedingly, do more and more' (from ፈድፋደ), 3fs perfect, with infinitives ሠዊዐ, ሰጊደ, and the noun ተውኔት 'revel, ritual play and dance' (?), accusative ተውኔተ. በከመ እበዶሙ ለግብጻዊያን: 'according to the folly (እበድ) of them, of the Egyptians' (anticipatory suffix, then ለ-). ወተምህሩ: ተምህረ 'learn' (tä-stem of ምህረ 'teach'), 3mp perfect; ሰብአ ቤታ 'men-of her house'. ወበአስተኣድሞ ሐውዘ ተውኔቶሙ: አስተኣድሞ is an infinitive 'taking delight' (?) with በ-, and ሐውዘ is unclear to me (?), perhaps 'power, charm' of their revels; I have not forced a sense for it. ኀብሩ is ኀብረ 'join, unite', repeated with 'sons of Israel' and then with the women and maidservants (አእማት, plural of አመት 'maidservant'). በተዋንዮ: infinitive of ተዋነየ 'revel, dance' (?). The sons of Israel joining in idolatry is the climax of the unit.

sentences.t: ወለሊሁኒ ፡ ያስተኣድም ፡ ሰሚዐ ፡ ተውኔታ ፡ ወእበዳ ።
sentences.l: And-he-himself-too takes-pleasure(?) hearing her-revelry and-her-folly.
sentences.i: And he himself took pleasure in hearing of her revels and her folly.
sentences.n: ወለሊሁኒ 'and he himself too' (ለሊሁ 'he himself' + -ኒ). ያስተኣድም: አስተኣደመ 'take delight in' (?), 3ms imperfect, from the same root as አስተኣድሞ above. ሰሚዐ: infinitive of ሰምዐ 'hear'. ተውኔታ ወእበዳ 'her revelry and her folly' (two nouns with -ኣ 'her'). Solomon passes from tolerating to enjoying.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ርእየት ፡ ከመ ፡ ያፈቅር ፡ ላቲ ፡ ወይሰምዕ ፡ ወያረምም ፡ ወየሐትት ፡ ተውኔተ ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ ፡ ለግብጻዊያን ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ታስተጣዕም ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወትነግሮ ፡ በጥዑም ፡ ቃል ፡ ወበድኩም ፡ ነገረ ፡ አንስት ፡ ወበአክሞስሶ ፡ ዘምስለ ፡ አርእዮ ፡ ምግባረ ፡ እኩይ ፡ በተመይጦ ፡ ገጽ ፡ ወበአሠንዮ ፡ ወበአትሕቶ ፡ ርእስ ፡ ወበዘከመዝ ፡ ታፈርስ ፡ ልቦ ፡ እምሠናይ ፡ ኅሊናሁ ፡ ወትቀጽቦ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እከየ ፡ ምግባራ ፡ ወትፈቅድ ፡ ታውርዶ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እበደ ፡ ተውኔተ ፡ ጣዖት ፡ በንዝህላል ፤
sentences.l: And-when she-saw that he-loves to-her(?) and-hears and-is-silent and-inquires revelry-of their-gods of-the-Egyptians, exceedingly she-made-sweet to-him and-told-him in-sweet word and-in-soft(?) speech-of women, and-in-አክሞስሶ(?) which with showing-him deed evil, in-turning face and-in-adorning and-in-lowering head; and-in-such-manner she-breaks(?) his-heart from good his-thought and-she-strikes-him(?) into evil-of her-deeds and-she-wishes to-bring-him-down into folly-of revelry-of idol in-negligence;
sentences.i: And when she saw that he was fond of her, and that he listened and kept quiet and kept asking about the revels of the gods of the Egyptians, she made them all the more pleasing to him, and told him with sweet words and soft (?) women's talk, and with አክሞስሶ (?), along with showing him evil conduct, with turning of her face and adorning and lowering of her head; and in such ways she tore (?) his heart from his good judgment and drove him (?) into the evil of her deeds, and she wished to bring him down into the folly of the idols' revels, through negligence;
sentences.n: Long (46 words) but without a ፤ to cut at, so left whole. Read it as a chain of 'when she saw that he ... , she ... ': ወሶበ ርእየት ከመ + four imperfects ያፈቅር, ይሰምዕ, ያረምም ('is silent', አረመመ (?)), የሐትት ('inquires', ሐተተ), then main verbs ታስተጣዕም ('she makes sweet', አስተጠዐመ, from ጠዐመ 'taste' / ጥዑም 'sweet') and ትነግሮ ('she tells him'). ያፈቅር ላቲ 'he loves to her' (ለ- + -ቲ), read 'was fond of her' (?). The means: በጥዑም ቃል ወበድኩም ነገረ አንስት 'with sweet word and soft (ድኩም, 'weak, soft' (?)) speech-of women'. በአክሞስሶ is unclear (?); the string ዘምስለ አርእዮ ምግባረ እኩይ 'which is with showing (him) evil conduct' follows. Then three infinitives of body-play with በ-: በተመይጦ ገጽ 'in turning the face', በአሠንዮ 'in adorning' (አሠነየ 'make beautiful'), በአትሕቶ ርእስ 'in lowering the head'. ታፈርስ: አፈረሰ 'break down, demolish' (?), + ልቦ 'his heart'; ትቀጽቦ: ቀጸበ 'strike, drive with a blow' (?) + -ሁ 'him'; ታውርዶ: አውረደ 'bring down' + -ሁ. በንዝህላል 'in negligence' (whose negligence, his or hers, is not said).

sentences.t: ወከመ ፡ ባሕር ፡ ዕሙቅ ፡ ዘይስሕብ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ልጐት ፡ ለዘ ፡ ኢይክል ፡ ጸቢተ ፡ እስከ ፡ የዐዝዞ ፡ ማይ ፡ ወየሀጒል ፡ ነፍሶ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ትፈቅድ ፡ አስጥሞቶ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ብእሲት ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሥ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-like sea deep which draws into depth(?) him-who not can swimming(?) until grips-him water and-destroys his-life, thus she-wishes to-drown-him, that woman, Solomon king.
sentences.i: As a deep sea draws into its depths the man who cannot swim (?), until the water seizes (?) him and destroys his life, so that woman wished to drown King Solomon.
sentences.n: A simile in ከመ ... ከማሁ 'as ... so'. ዘይስሕብ: 'which draws', ሰሐበ 'drag, draw', with ውስተ ልጐት 'into the deep (?)', a word I take as 'depth, abyss' (?). ለዘ ኢይክል: 'to him who cannot' (ለ- + ዘ + ኢይክል, ከህለ 'be able'), with ጸቢተ 'to swim' (?), an infinitive that I have not been able to confirm. እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ: 'until the water grips him' (ዐዘዘ 'seize, overpower' (?)). ወየሀጒል ነፍሶ: አሀጐለ 'destroy', with ነፍሶ 'his life/soul' as object. ትፈቅድ አስጥሞቶ: 'she wishes to drown him': ፈቀደ + the infinitive of አስጠመ 'submerge, drown' + -ሁ 'him'. ይእቲ ብእሲት 'that woman' is the Egyptian queen; ለሰሎሞን ንጉሥ marks the object. The ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ closes the part.
